parameters.name: Interfaces
parameters.description: {{reference|the {{object|###.IP.Interface}} object instance that this server will use as its host address to receive USP messages}} {{empty}} will bind this server to all interfaces for this device.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number used by the WebSocket Server to receive USP messages.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The service path that is provided by the WebSocket Server in order to exchange USP messages. The value MUST be used as defined in {{bibref|RFC3986|Section 3.3}}.

parameters.name: EnableEncryption
parameters.description: When {{true}}, encryption MUST be used for all connections to this MTP instance.

parameters.name: KeepAliveInterval
parameters.description: The duration in {{units}} between when WebSocket ping control frames are transmitted by the Agent's WebSocket server to the Controller's WebSocket client.

object.description: If the USP Endpoint uses the WebSocket Message Transfer Protocol (MTP) as a WebSocket server, then this object contains WebSocket specific configuration parameters.
